5621.title: Native tool details are discarded before timeline rendering
5621.rootCauseOneLine: Native Read/Grep/Glob lose input details and result text during provider translation, and the client explicitly disables disclosure for file-read/search rows.
5621.proposedFix: Preserve bounded native tool details end to end and add disclosure using shared timeline rendering; this crosses provider, shared contracts, and client subsystems and is not eligible for a simple autopilot fix.
5621.caveats: Both provider and production React regressions repeated in two clean trusted checkouts. Live provider/desktop hover and screenshots were not verified because Chrome/Chromium is unavailable. Complete tests are inline in the report.
